description: My landlord taped a notice to quit on my door and I'm three weeks behind on rent after my hours got cut.

referrals.label: Eviction / loss of housing
referrals.serviceDescription: Eviction defense and housing stability help through your local legal aid housing unit.
referrals.whereToGo: Your nearest legal aid office or court self-help center; bring any court papers you received.

guidance.point: Bring every notice, summons, or letter you have received to your first appointment; deadlines printed on court papers are time-sensitive.
Court self-help centers can explain what each paper means at no cost; intake staff can point you to the nearest one.

disclaimer: This tool provides referral information only. It does not provide legal advice, does not evaluate the merits of any claim, and is not a substitute for a licensed attorney.

description: There is black mold in the bathroom and no heat since October; the landlord ignores my repair requests.

referrals.label: Repairs / unhealthy housing conditions
referrals.serviceDescription: Housing conditions enforcement help through your local legal aid housing unit.
referrals.whereToGo: Your nearest legal aid office; bring photos, repair requests, and correspondence with the landlord.

guidance.point: Take photos of the problem and keep copies of repair requests; bring both to your appointment.
Many localities have a housing code enforcement office that inspects on request; intake staff can identify yours.

disclaimer: This tool provides referral information only. It does not provide legal advice, does not evaluate the merits of any claim, and is not a substitute for a licensed attorney.

description: They denied my food stamps and said I have an overpayment I don't understand.
primaryLabel: Public benefits denied or cut off

referrals.label: Public benefits denied or cut off
referrals.serviceDescription: Benefits appeals help (fair hearings) through your local legal aid public benefits unit.
referrals.whereToGo: Your nearest legal aid office; bring the denial or overpayment notice and any deadlines listed on it.

guidance.point: Appeal deadlines are printed on the denial or overpayment notice; bring the notice to intake staff right away.
A fair hearing can often be requested by phone or mail; the notice itself explains how.

disclaimer: This tool provides referral information only. It does not provide legal advice, does not evaluate the merits of any claim, and is not a substitute for a licensed attorney.

description: A debt collector is suing me over an old credit card and threatened wage garnishment.

referrals.label: Debt collection / credit
referrals.serviceDescription: Consumer debt defense help through your local legal aid consumer unit.
referrals.whereToGo: Your nearest legal aid office; bring the collection letters or lawsuit papers.

guidance.point: Bring all collection letters, voicemails, and court papers to your appointment.
Summons papers include a response deadline; bring them to intake staff the same week they arrive.

description: My partner hit me and I'm scared; I think I need a restraining order.

referrals.label: Domestic violence / safety
referrals.serviceDescription: Safety planning and protective-order help through a domestic violence advocacy program.
referrals.whereToGo: A DV advocacy hotline or legal aid DV unit; if you are in immediate danger call emergency services first.

guidance.point: If you are in immediate danger, call emergency services before anything else.
Safety planning with a trained advocate is free and confidential; advocates also help with protective-order paperwork.

description: I wasn't paid for six weeks of overtime at my last job.

referrals.label: Wage theft / job problems
referrals.serviceDescription: Wage claim and employment help through your local legal aid workers’ rights unit.
referrals.whereToGo: Your nearest legal aid office; bring pay stubs, schedules, and any termination notice.

guidance.point: Bring pay stubs, schedules, and any messages about hours or pay.
Wage claims are handled by a state or federal labor agency; intake staff can identify the right office for your situation.

description: I want to get my criminal record expunged so background checks stop killing my applications.
